searchDocs.title: UpdateDirection​
searchDocs.content: </> Projectile:UpdateDirection(Direction: Vector3 ) → () Starts a new trajectory segment from wherever the projectile is right now. This is the only thing that puts an update on the wire. Called from a Hit handler it instead rebases to the exact point and moment of contact, so a deflection does not depend on which sub-frame phase the projectile happened to be cast on. Two identical shots into identical geometry then leave in identical directions.

searchDocs.title: Destroy​
searchDocs.content: </> Projectile:Destroy() → () Destroys the projectile. this method will destroy the projectile and all of its connections. It's auto called if there is a max distance specified and the projectile reaches it.

searchDocs.content: This item only works when running on the client. Client </> ProjectileCaster.GetAll() → Projectile[] returns all projectiles that are currently active

searchDocs.title: Cast​
searchDocs.content: </> ProjectileCaster:Cast( Start:: Vector3 , Direction:: Vector3 , VisualOverride:: Instance? ) → Projectile Casts a new projectile in the game world. VisualOverride is an optional parameter that allows you to override the default visual of the projectile. VisualOverride must be a descendant of ReplicatedStorage.
